theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro s₁ s₂ hr
    cases hr <;> constructor <;> exact Bisimilarity.symm ‹_›
  · intro s₁ s₂ hr μ s' ht
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        exact (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ => And.imp Tr.choiceL ChoiceBisim.bisim
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | bisim h => exact (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ => And.imp_right ChoiceBisim.bisim
